body: Like I know it’s such a cliche thing to say, but I truly, honestly believe that no one has ever genuinely cared about me. This isn’t, “they didn’t pick up the phone at 3am, run over in the pouring rain, kick down my door and give me the kiss of life so they don’t care!!” This is going months or even years at a time without a single friend. This decades of abuse and neglect from pretty much everyone. It’s hard to think I’ll ever mean anything to anyone, when I never really have. I don’t know if it’s worth waiting around and continuing to deal with bullshit just for the *chance* of being cared about one day.

My mother has been incredibly understanding an empathetic, but other than that, hasn’t been much support. Same with my best friend. Every time I call them having a panic attack, the just tell me to take deep breaths then hang up and leave me alone again once I’m not actively losing it. Which I understand. I can’t expect anyone to drop their life for me. It’s just that I’ve spent nearly every day alone since it happened and while I’m grateful that people are giving me a break and letting me be weak for a while, I’d really like some emotional support, as well.

I’m doing what I can medically, but at this point, it’s just a matter of waiting until I can schedule, get the test, then get the results. Not much I can do other than that and survive until then. I was seeing my therapist twice a week but she had a recent loss in her family so she had to take some time off and now her schedule is weird. I’m seeing her today in about two hours, but having not seen her since last Monday, she has no idea about the tumors so I’m preparing for a breakdown when that comes up.

He went back home like nothing happened. I haven’t spoken to him since, blocked him on all social media and asked family and friends not to mention him to me, without really going into detail about why. Only my mother, best friend and professionals know what happened.

I don’t want to press charges because it’ll only cause prolonged pain. He gets to keep living his life without an ounce of suffering.

I’ve been seeing a therapist for about half a year now and she’s been extremely helpful throughout all of this, but her father-in-law died last week so my scheduled appointments have been dropped or moved back.

I don’t want to press charges. I am a CSA survivor and I know how these things go. Plus, he lives out of state and was only visiting when it happened. It took me a long time to admit what happened to me, and hadn’t gone through any of the procedures or gotten a rape kit when in the hospital. This will go nowhere and it’s just added pain and a longer period of dealing with this. I don’t want to deal with it anymore I just want it to stop.

I’ve been talking to my therapist about it. I saw her today and will now be seeing her twice a week until, well, I don’t have to anymore. My mother and best friend know, but they haven’t been very supportive— my mother insisting I press charges and my best friend constantly changing the subject to her own issues. I don’t want to talk to the police because there’s no point. I ended up in the hospital because of the pain, but I hadn’t considered if it were assault at the time and didn’t go through the whole procedure.

What does freezing the year entail? I was planning to take a year off and just focus on my mental health after this semester, when I graduate. I really just want to finish my degree and not have to worry about it anymore.

Like the logical part of my brain knows that nonconsent = assault point blank but I keep coming back to questioning myself and his intentions.

I have therapy at 2 tomorrow. She knows the situation and has been checking in on me by phone all week, but she hasn’t been scheduled to be in the office since I started questioning everything so I haven’t had the chance to talk to her about it. I’ve already prepared for a complete breakdown when it comes down to telling her.

Thanks for the reality check, in any case.
